name: Предусилитель Parasound 200 Pre
descriptionHtml:
Предусилитель Parasound 200 Pre — Compact two-channel analogue control preamplifier with Burr-Brown 192 kHz/24-bit DAC, USB/optical/coax digital inputs, MM/MC phono, analogue bass management, Home Theater Bypass and remote-controlled subwoofer functions. Характеристики ниже — только с страницы/листа производителя.

  • 20 Hz–20 kHz (+0/-0.05 dB); 10 Hz–80 kHz (+0/-3 dB)
  • THD: <0.03% (20 Hz–20 kHz)
  • Phono gain/input impedance: MM: 40 dB / 47 kOhm; MC: 50 dB / 100 ohm
  • Line input impedance: 24 kOhm
  • Output impedance: 470 ohms

Характеристики производителя

Frequency response: 20 Hz–20 kHz (+0/-0.05 dB); 10 Hz–80 kHz (+0/-3 dB) · THD: <0.03% (20 Hz–20 kHz) · Phono gain/input impedance: MM: 40 dB / 47 kOhm; MC: 50 dB / 100 ohm · Line input impedance: 24 kOhm · Output impedance: 470 ohms · Bass-management high-pass: Variable 20–140 Hz.
